outcome: Whole blood viscosity (high and low shear rates)
cohort: The study included 43 singleton pregnant women with Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy and 45 singleton healthy pregnant women (with indications for cesarean section) who delivered at Shaanxi Provincial People's Hospital between June 2014 and June 2015.
finding: Pregnant women with ICP exhibited significantly higher levels of inflammatory cytokines, increased hemorheological viscosity, and hypercoagulability, which were associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes such as amniotic fluid pollution and premature delivery.
